stimulus.scripted_visible_incident: Morgan sprints toward Riley. Riley steps backward toward the open exit path. Morgan moves into the exit path and stops one block in front of Riley. observer_actions.Casey: Casey moves between Morgan and Riley, steps into the blocked path, replaces the broken fence post, picks up and rehangs the dropped lantern on Riley’s side, and stands facing Morgan to hold the reopened corridor.

target_reaction: Riley lowers their gaze, turns slightly toward the wall, sidesteps along the wall away from Morgan, back-steps to create a one-block gap, moves toward the observer line near Taylor and Jordan, stops beside them with empty hands, and faces the worksite at a calm distance.
